**Russian Federation: how applications changed.** The extract records 799,455 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 81,075 in 2023, compared with 31,748 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 14% higher than in 2019 (27,730). Applications in 2025 were 28% lower than in 2024 (43,914). In 2025, the leading destinations were Germany (11,562; 36%), United States (5,104; 16%), France (3,988; 13%). Germany received 36% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 16% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 28%, across 26,262 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 33% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 5.3 percentage points lower than in 2024 (33%).
